attributes.description:
This is a supernatural evangelism workshop/weekend with guest speaker Chris Overstreet.

The goal is activating and equipping the body of Christ to continue the transformative ministry of Jesus Christ!

  • We want every Christian to know their identity in Christ.
  • We want every Christian to know that they can be used by God.
  • We want every Christian to know the pleasure of seeing others get saved through their personal witness.
  • We want every Christian to know the pleasure of seeing the sick healed as they pray for them.
  • We want every Christian to experience the pleasure of baptizing a new Christian in water.

Weekends Schedule: 

Saturday
8:30am-10am leaders gathering How to develop a culture of evangelism and discipleship. This is for senior leaders/business leaders. 

10:30am- 12  Equipping 
12-1pm - Lunch on the Go (Provided)
12:30-3pm compassion to action activation
3:30 testimonies 
4:30 dinner break (on your own)

  • area restaurants 

7pm Night service

Sunday
10am Compassion to Action/Sunday Service 
7pm Additional Service

attributes.description:
Are you passionate about worship and interested in using technology to enchance the experience?  Join us for a hands-on audio training session designed to equip you with the essential skills to serve your church through sound.  This training is not about complex technical jargon.  Instead, we'll focus on practical, easy-to-understand concepts that will have you up and running the sound system in no time. Whether you're a seasoned audio engineer or just starting out, this session will provide valuable insights.

Key Takeaways:

  • Basic audio equipment and its functions
  • Essential mixing console techniques
  • Microphone placement and usage
  • Troubleshooting common sound issues
  • Best practices for sound reinforcement

Come join us and discover how you can use your skills to create a powerful and impactful worship experience.  Lunch will be provided!
attributes.name: Church Audio Training: A Practical Guide to Serving Through Sound

attributes.description:
Winter Retreat 2025 is HERE!

Special Guest Speakers: Pastor Mike & Tara O’Brien

Purpose and Mission for the "Consuming Fire" Cornerstone Teen 2025 Winter Retreat:

That, as we immerse ourselves in the Word (both in the Old and New Testaments), in Teaching and Discussions, in Fellowship, in Worship, in the Breaking of Bread, and in Prayer, that OUR HEARTS WOULD BURN WITHIN US (Luke 24:32), and we will recognize Jesus Christ for Who He is in our lives.

That we will express that outwardly, that we will testify to one another and to others about what He has done in us, through us, and for us by the power of His Holy Spirit while we were here together.

That we will take this light and let it shine for others (Luke 8:16), that their hearts, too, may burn with fire for Him!

FOR OUR GOD IS A CONSUMING FIRE! (Hebrews 12:29)

Sign up to join in the fun, fellowship, worship, and the Word for an unforgettable weekend!

Parent/Youth Informational Meeting:

Sunday, January 12th, for 12:15 P.M. in the South Wing after Sunday Service

Registration and Payment Deadline:
January 22nd

Food Allergies:
Please be sure to let Theresa Royland know of any food allergies no later than January 22nd.

Classes will be held on Thursday evenings.  The 10 year olds and up will meet from 6:00 - 7:30 p.m.  Classes start January 23rd and run through May 22nd.  The registration fee is $50 for the semester.  
(However, we never want financial strain to prevent children from coming, so please let us know if this is a concern.)

For class uniform, please wear stretchable black pants and team t-shirt which will be provided.  Dancers may dance in bare feet or dance shoes.  No socks, please.  Hair should be pulled up and out of the face.  Please have dancers bring their tambourine and a water bottle.  A tambourine will be provided if the dancer does not yet have her/his own.

attributes.description:
COME TO THE TABLE

2025 is the time to gather—not around celebrity personalities, but for a great communion revival centered on Jesus, who is alive, well, and moving right now in this generation. He is the dream of a generation.

We are gathering on the National Mall in Washington, DC in 50 tents of nonstop worship—one tent for each state—with thousands of worshippers, prayer, gospel proclamation, and commissioning every night.

On October 11, we will host a communion table the length of the whole National Mall in Washington, D.C.

IT’S A FESTIVAL AROUND THE PRESENCE OF GOD

Click HERE to go to the website for more information.

Registrations for the bus and hotel rooms close September 7

Departure: October 9 at 7 am from Cornerstone Church
Return: We will depart DC on October 11 about 7pm arriving back at Cornerstone at about 3 am on October 12.

Cornerstone has booked a bus at the cost of $200 per person round trip and also will be taking up a collection of $20 per person on the bus for the bus driver's tip. Your  $200 "registration" pays for the bus portion of the trip.

In addition, we have blocked out rooms at a near-by hotel within walking distance.  YOU are responsible for booking and paying for your own rooms.  Click HERE to book a room.  We will be spending two nights there. The room block closes on September 7 so book now.

Please note: if we are unable to sell out the bus, we will have to cancel 30 days prior and you will have to either find your own way to DC or cancel your own hotel reservation. The money for the bus portion will be refunded from Cornerstone.

Missions Workshop – Reaching the Unreached 

More than 3 billion people have little to no access to the Gospel — no Bibles, no churches, no believers nearby. These Unreached and Unengaged People Groups (UUPGs) are living and dying without ever hearing the name of Jesus.

          But you can be part of changing that.

We invite you to join us for a powerful Missions Workshop focused on equipping and mobilizing believers to reach the last, the least, and the lost. This is more than a seminar — it’s a call to action.

 What to Expect:

 • A biblical vision for the nations

 • Firsthand stories from the frontlines of missions

 • Strategic insight into how to reach UUPGs

 • Practical steps for engagement – whether by going, sending, praying, or giving

This is the Great Commission in its rawest, most urgent form — and it’s not optional. Come and discover your role in God’s global mission.

Spots are limited — RSVP now and take your first step toward the unreached.

MAKE SURE TO REGISTER YOUR CHILDREN IF YOU NEED CHILDCARE FOR THOSE OVER THE AGE OF 2!!
